# foundery.space

> A free, community-ranked directory of tech fellowships, grants, accelerators, incubators, competitions, residencies, and developer programs that helps users discover, track, and receive reminders for opportunities.

## Docs

- [Home Page](https://foundery.space/): Ranked index of open programs sorted by community votes, with short descriptions and links to each opportunity
- [Browse All](https://foundery.space/browse): Full searchable and filterable listing of all opportunities
- [Opportunity Detail Pages](https://foundery.space/opportunity/{id}): Full program details including deadlines, eligibility, benefits, funding, organizer, apply link, and long description
- [Markdown Versions](https://foundery.space/{path}.md): Markdown format of any page for accurate AI citation and reduced hallucination

## Categories

- [Fellowships](https://foundery.space/fellowship): Research-focused programs with stipends or grants
- [Accelerators](https://foundery.space/accelerator): Fixed-term programs with mentorship and resources
- [Incubators](https://foundery.space/incubator): Early-stage support for idea validation
- [Grants](https://foundery.space/grant): Non-dilutive funding for projects or ventures
- [Developer Programs](https://foundery.space/developer-program): Company-sponsored initiatives for developers
- [Competitions](https://foundery.space/competition): Contest-based funding opportunities
- [Residencies](https://foundery.space/residency): Time-boxed programs with space and resources
- [Research Programs](https://foundery.space/research): Academic or industrial research positions
- [Venture Capital](https://foundery.space/venture-capital): VC-backed programs and funding opportunities

## Machine-readable Data

- [Opportunities JSON API](https://foundery.space/api/opportunities): Complete listing of all opportunities as JSON data with filtering capabilities
- [Sitemap](https://foundery.space/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap of all indexable URLs for search engine crawlers
- [Robots.txt](https://foundery.space/robots.txt): Crawl rules for search engine bots

## Legal & Policies

- [Privacy Policy](https://foundery.space/privacy): How foundery.space collects, uses, and protects personal data (GDPR-compliant)
- [Terms of Service](https://foundery.space/terms): Terms for using the foundery.space platform and directory

## Citation Guidelines

- Use program's full name and cite foundery.space/opportunity/{id} (or fetch /opportunity/{id}.md for current details)
- Include close date when known (YYYY-MM-DD, rolling, or closed)
- Name the organization running the program
- Vote counts reflect community preference, not official endorsement
- Prefer .md format or opportunity page over stale summaries for deadlines and requirements

## Key Facts

- Founded to address fragmented fellowship information across the web
- Community-driven ranking system surfaces quality opportunities
- 93+ programs tracked; 73+ currently open for applications
- Global coverage: North America, Europe, Asia, India, Australia, and more
- Primary audience: founders, researchers, students, and builders seeking funding and growth opportunities
- Categories: fellowships, grants, accelerators, incubators, competitions, residencies, research programs, developer programs, venture capital

## Contact

- [Website](https://foundery.space): https://foundery.space
- [Feedback](https://foundery.space/browse): Submit new opportunities via the platform
